Three rod-SBU frameworks from CoRE MOF 2024's supporting-information
subset, as distributed in CoRE MOF Tools (CoREMOF/data/SI/CR.zip),
unchanged. CoRE's nets (CrystalNets) in brackets, single-node / all-node:

  2019[Zn][pts]3[ASR]3.cif  doi:10.1039/C8DT04252G (pts-x / none); Zn joined
                            along the rod through carboxylate O bridging two Zn
  2020[Zn][fgl]3[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1021/jacs.0c03853 (fgl / ggl); Zn spanned
                            only syn-syn by carboxylates, so not joined
  2024[Cu][tfz]3[ASR]1.cif  doi:10.1039/d2cc06283f (tfz / tfz); Cu2O2 rods of
                            inorganic mu-O

G. Zhao, L. Brabson, S. Chheda, J. Huang, H. Kim, K. Liu et al., CoRE MOF DB:
a curated experimental metal-organic framework database with machine-learned
properties for integrated material-process screening, Matter 8, 102140 (2025).
Licence CC-BY-4.0. Used by tests/test_topology_rods.py (round 70).
